description: The U.K. National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) has reviewed Selpercatinib. Selpercatinib is recommended with managed access as an option for treating RET fusion-positive advanced non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC) in adults, only if: • it is untreated • the conditions in the managed access agreement for selpercatinib are followed.
